headline: Mod browsing and updates arrive alongside graphics, controls and audio fixes
summary: The development launcher gained a mod index, install links, dependency handling and automatic updates with rollback. Game changes address slow diagonal stick movement, Windows sound gaps and missing or wrongly coloured effects, while Enhanced graphics received phone GPU optimisations. Desktop setup and debugging also gained display scaling, Steam integration and new inspection tools.
highlights: Mod installation now handles dependencies and automatic updates with rollback; the launcher also supports sharing a setup (#161).
Diagonal stick movement now preserves the speed of an equally strong straight push (#168).
Windows fixes restore Orxon's electric barrier strands and correct blue explosion debris (#171, #178).
Audio mixing moves ahead of the device to address Windows sound gaps, and Vulkan becomes the default renderer (#188).
The mod interface adds a data folder per mod and access to the current save slot (#172).
Audio replacement, another co-op round and a Going Commando native port opened as proposals; none merged that day (#164, #166, #191).
